title: Time Complexity Analysis
definition: Evaluating the number of elementary operations performed by an algorithm. We drop constants and lower-order terms (e.g., O(2N + 5) becomes O(N)).
simpleExplanation: Counting exactly how many steps a computer has to take to finish the math.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Time Complexity.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Time Complexity to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Time Complexity (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Time Complexity for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Time Complexity in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
